title: Add the ability to clear all on-screen notifications that require manual dismissal at once
line: Clear All in the notifications widget now also dismisses notifications still on screen, such as critical ones that never time out.
explanation: The widget's Clear All button (and the Clear Notification History shortcut) only removed expired notifications, so popups that must be closed by hand stayed on screen, and the button was hidden when nothing had expired. Notifications from apps without a desktop file (notify-send, the reporter's case) are also kept out of the history list, so the widget offered no way to get rid of them at all. The change adds a ClearActive flag to Notifications::clear(), which Clear All and the shortcut now pass together with ClearExpired; running jobs are never cleared. The button shows whenever the history or the popups contain something to clear.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: also dismiss on-screen notifications on Clear All

Clear All only removed expired notifications, so popups that need to be
closed by hand stayed on screen however many piled up. It now also closes
those, running jobs are kept, and the button shows whenever there are any.

BUG: 518237

media.caption: Master: an old Dolphin notification in the history and three critical notify-send popups on screen; Clear All is in the header.
Fix: same state before pressing Clear All.
Master: after Clear All only the history is gone, the three popups stay.
Fix: after Clear All the popups are dismissed too.
Master: only notify-send popups on screen, the widget shows no Clear All button.
Fix: the Clear All button is offered for the on-screen popups (clicking it dismissed them and closed the widget).
